ajusta.title: Ajusta
description: Product: Built a personal finance app that splits the month, starting on payday, into calendar segments, with savings pockets, installment commitments and per-category budgets.

Local-first Architecture: Designed offline sync where the UI reads only from the local copy (IndexedDB on web, SQLite on mobile) and every write goes into a queue that syncs in the background, with client-generated UUIDs and last-write-wins resolution.

Cross-platform Monorepo: Structured a pnpm monorepo with a domain core shared by the API (Express and Drizzle on PostgreSQL), the web app (React and Vite) and the mobile app (Expo with a native Kotlin module).

Secure by Design: Isolated each user's data by deriving identity only from the session and scoping every query at the repository layer; cross-tenant reads return 404 so resource existence is never leaked.

jarvis.title: Jarvis (Android)
description: Product: Developed an Android reminder assistant with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose that reads every alert out loud with TextToSpeech, even when the phone is on silent.
Alarm Engine: Implemented exact alarms with AlarmManager that survive reboots, with a foreground service, full-screen alerts and repeat rules (once, weekly or intra-day intervals) persisted in Room.
Extensible Design: Modeled each reminder's actions as serializable sealed interfaces, so a new action never touches the scheduler, the database or the UI; wrote Robolectric tests running on the JVM.

whvn.title: WHVN
description: Product: Built a wallpaper browser with Astro on top of the Wallhaven API, with a terminal look, keyboard shortcuts and 48 results per page.

Server-side Rendering: Moved every API call to the server to keep the API key secret and work around the missing CORS headers, validating responses with Zod and caching them with TTL and deduplication to stay under the 45 requests-per-minute limit.
URL as State: Put filters, sorting and pagination in the URL, so links are shareable, the back button works and the page runs even without JavaScript.

blog.title: Tech blog
description: Product: Launched my tech blog with Astro on GitHub Pages, with RSS, sitemap and Spanish and English versions.
Publishing Pipeline: Automated with GitHub Actions the path from my Obsidian notes to the web: only flagged notes are synced, transformed and deployed, with no CMS.
Content Transformation: Wrote a Node.js script that turns wikilinks into real links without ever producing a broken one, and aborts on URL collisions before publishing.

job1.title: Full-stack Developer & AI Engineer
description: Software Architecture: Design and implementation of e-commerce and marketplace solutions following Clean Architecture principles and design patterns, ensuring scalable, maintainable, and decoupled code.

E-commerce Development: Built online stores and commerce platforms on Shopify (themes, apps, and integrations via the Shopify API) and developed custom e-commerce and marketplace solutions with Next.js.
AI Agents for Business: Designed and integrated AI agents specialized in business logic, automating commercial and decision-making processes within e-commerce flows.

Cybersecurity Audits: Performing security audits of the e-commerce platforms (code, configuration and third-party integrations) using the OWASP Top 10 as a baseline, then building the fixes: remediating vulnerabilities, hardening configurations and embedding security by design into the development lifecycle.
Best Practices: Applied SOLID principles and clean architecture across the stack, ensuring consistency between frontend, backend, and third-party integrations.

job2.title: Mobile Developer & Data Analyst
description: Mobile Development: Designed and implemented new features in mobile applications using React Native, focusing on performance optimization and user experience (UX/UI).

Data Engineering: Acted as a data analyst, building and orchestrating automated and scalable data pipelines (ETL) using Python and Apache Airflow, ensuring data integrity and availability for decision-making.

Quality & DevOps: Established code quality standards through advanced Git and GitHub management. Implemented branching strategies (Git Flow), thorough code reviews, and collaborative workflows to synchronize distributed teams.

Critical Incident Mitigation (DDoS): Immediately responded to and resolved an active DDoS attack. Analyzed traffic to identify the attack vector and configured Cloudflare on-the-fly (I'm Under Attack Mode, Rate Limiting, and WAF rules), successfully mitigating 99% of malicious traffic and restoring service availability within minutes.

job3.title: Technical Consultant and Mentor
description: Consulting: Provided custom technical solutions for various clients, focusing on refactoring legacy code to improve its maintainability and scalability.
Mentorship: Led training for junior developers, instructing them in clean architectures, design patterns, and professional use of version control systems.
Optimization: Analyzed and improved development workflows, reducing technical debt and accelerating delivery times.

job4.title: Full-stack Developer
description: System Modernization: Led the migration of legacy platforms to modern Single Page Application (SPA) architectures using ReactJS and Redux, significantly improving interface speed and responsiveness.
Backend & Microservices: Developed robust services for international applications (such as Mesadoko) using Node.js, Express, and Prisma, implementing a modular microservices architecture.
Secure Infrastructure: Strengthened application security by implementing DDoS attack protections and configured CI/CD pipelines for automated and secure deployments.

job5.title: Technical Lead
description: Product Management: Directed the complete development lifecycle of RCService, a comprehensive administrative solution for real estate management.

Multi-platform Development: Built the complete ecosystem: a scalable RESTful API, an administrative web panel, and a native mobile application, ensuring real-time synchronization across all platforms.
